1 Kings 20:10.bridge: Ben-hadad then demands the right to search and plunder Samaria; on the elders' advice Ahab refuses.

2 Kings 1:13.bridge: A second captain and his fifty are likewise consumed by fire.

2 Kings 3:9.bridge: Jehoram of Israel persuades Jehoshaphat of Judah to join him, and they march on Moab by way of Edom.

2 Kings 8:26.bridge: Jehoram of Judah dies after eight years, and his son Ahaziah succeeds him.

2 Kings 10:6.bridge: Jehu dares the leaders of Samaria to crown one of Ahab's seventy sons and fight him; terrified, they submit to him instead.

2 Kings 12:6.bridge: Jehoash orders the priests to use the money given at the temple to repair it.

2 Kings 13:14.bridge: Jehu's son Jehoahaz dies, and his grandson Joash becomes king of Israel.

2 Kings 14:25.bridge: Amaziah is later killed in a conspiracy and his son Azariah takes Judah's throne; in Israel, Jehoash's son Jeroboam II reigns forty-one years.
